Process block diagram for the base-case FT process. Woody Biomass. The biomass feedstock used in this assessment was assumed have a moisture content of 30 wt % at the plant gate. The feedstock cost was $63/dry ton per Idaho National Laboratory’s Woody Feedstocks 2020 State of Technology Report (Hartley, Thompson, and Cai 2021). The plant scale was set at 2,205 dry tons of feedstock per day. Table 18 shows the FT-SPK jet fuel production potential from woody biomass within 50- and 100-mile radii of PWM. Assuming a centralized conversion facility, HC production potential is estimated at about 15–53 MMgge/yr within 50- and 100-mile radii of PWM. These large numbers reflect the high population in the area generating feedstock.
